title: Listening Drill — Library acoustics
description: Short academic talk. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Library acoustics
sections.transcript:
PRESENTER: Today I'm describing a small study of noise in shared study spaces. I want you to listen for how the researchers measured change, because the result is easy to overstate.

PRESENTER: Their work took place in two branches of a library. Instead of relying on what local people remembered, they recorded sound levels. They noticed quieter mornings. That observation would have been missed if the team had visited only at the end.

PRESENTER: The largest limitation was exam season. The report is therefore a starting point. In a follow-up, the team would add holiday weeks. A wider study could show whether the original pattern holds.
